newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Cera to expand in Netherlands, Switzerland.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Cera to expand in Netherlands, Switzerland.

text.p: Belgian Cera Bank said on Thursday it was due to open its first office in the Netherlands later this year and was planning an acquisition in Switzerland.

Chief executive officer Willy Breesch told a news conference on 1996 earnings that Cera was due to open its first Dutch branch in the town of Maastricht in September after a try-out period starting just before the summer.
He said Cera, Belgium's sixth-largest bank, would open "a few additional" branches in the Netherlands if the Maastricht office met expectations.
He said Cera was "quite hopeful" it could make the acquisition in Switzerland before the summer holidays but declined to give further details.
Cera's 1996 consolidated net profit soared 71.2 percent to 5.78 billion Belgian francs.
